name: Git
description: Git tracks changes, supports team workflows, and helps you recover safely from mistakes. These snippets cover daily work plus small project release habits.

snippets.title: Initial Git Setup
snippets.codeDes: Configure your identity and sensible defaults once.
snippets.code:
git config --global user.name "Your Name"
git config --global user.email "you@example.com"
git config --global init.defaultBranch main
git config --global pull.rebase true

snippets.title: Start a Repository and First Commit
snippets.codeDes: Initialize repository history and create a clean baseline commit.
snippets.code:
git init
git add .
git commit -m "chore: initial project scaffold"

snippets.title: Feature Branch Workflow
snippets.codeDes: Always build features on isolated branches to keep main stable.
snippets.code:
git switch -c feat/task-filter
# make changes
git add src/components/TaskList.jsx
git commit -m "feat: add task filter buttons"
git push -u origin feat/task-filter

snippets.title: Useful Commit Message Pattern
snippets.codeDes: Use conventional prefixes so history is searchable and release notes are easier.
snippets.code:
feat: add pomodoro timer
fix: handle empty task submission
docs: add setup instructions
refactor: split task reducer logic
test: add TaskForm interaction test

snippets.title: Rebase Your Branch on Latest Main
snippets.codeDes: Keep your branch current and avoid large merge commits in pull requests.
snippets.code:
git fetch origin
git switch feat/task-filter
git rebase origin/main

snippets.title: Resolve a Merge Conflict
snippets.codeDes: After fixing conflict markers, continue the rebase cleanly.
snippets.code:
git status
# edit conflicted files and remove <<<<<<< markers
git add path/to/file
git rebase --continue

snippets.title: Stash Work in Progress
snippets.codeDes: Temporarily park local changes when you need to switch context fast.
snippets.code:
git stash push -m "wip: timer styles"
git switch main
git stash list
git stash pop

snippets.title: Mini Project: Release with Tags
snippets.codeDes: For learning projects, practice simple releases. Tag versions so you can reference exact snapshots.
snippets.code:
git switch main
git pull origin main
git tag -a v1.0.0 -m "First stable release"
git push origin v1.0.0

snippets.title: Find Regressions with git bisect
snippets.codeDes: Binary search your history to locate the commit that introduced a bug.
snippets.code:
git bisect start
git bisect bad
git bisect good <known-good-commit>
# run tests at each step, then mark good/bad
git bisect reset

snippets.title: Undo Safely Without Losing History
snippets.codeDes: Prefer reversible commands over history-destroying operations.
snippets.code:
git restore path/to/file
git restore --staged path/to/file
git revert <commit-hash>

snippets.title: Daily Command Checklist
snippets.codeDes: Simple routine for reliable local collaboration.
snippets.code:
1. git switch main && git pull
2. git switch -c feat/your-change
3. git add -p and commit in small chunks
4. git fetch && git rebase origin/main
5. push branch and open pull request
